newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines welcomes news of debt rating review.
newsitem.headline: Philippines welcomes news of debt rating review.

text.p: The Philiipines on Friday welcomed news that Moody's Investors Service has placed its sovereign bonds on review for a possible upgrade from its current Ba2 rating.
Finance Secretary Roberto de Ocampo told Reuters that he was happy to hear the news but not surprised.
"There have been many studies that show the Philippines compares favourably with other countries that are at the same credit rating," he said in a telephone interview.
"I am glad this signal is early in 1997 as it will further consolidate international perceptions of the Philippines as the primary investment destination of choice," he said.
Moody's said the review was prompted by the successful macro-economic policies implemented by the government in recent years, in particular the substantial effort made in fiscal adjustment.

The government's commitment to strengthening its fiscal accounts has been reflected in its pursuit and implementation of important tax measures, including an expanded value-added-tax and the crucial excise tax passed last November, it said.
As part of the review process, Moody's said it will focus on both the political and economic factors affecting the sustainability of these favourable developments over the medium-term.
